ab-wheel-rollout.cue: From the knees. Brace hard, stop before the back arches.

ab-wheel-rollout-knees.cue: From the knees. Brace hard, stop before the back arches.

arnold-press.cue: Palms to you at the chin. Turn them out as you press up.

assisted-pull-up-machine.cue: Knees on the pad. Full hang, chin over the handles.

back-extension.cue: Pad below the hips. Lower with a flat back, rise to a straight line.

band-assisted-pull-ups.cue: Band under the knees or feet. Full hang, chin over the bar.

band-curl.cue: Stand on the band, elbows pinned. Curl up, lower slowly.

band-lat-pulldown.cue: Kneel under a high anchor. Elbows down to the ribs, chest up.

band-lateral-raise.cue: Stand on the band. Raise to shoulder height, lower slowly.

band-overhead-extension.cue: Band under the back foot. Elbows by the ears, lower behind, extend.

band-pallof-press.cue: Band at chest height, side-on. Press out, hold a second, don't twist.

band-pull-apart.cue: Arms straight at shoulder height. Pull the band to the chest, squeeze.

band-pull-through.cue: Band low behind, between the legs. Hips back, then drive them through.

barbell-bench-press.cue: Shoulder blades pinned. Bar to the lower chest, press up over the eyes.

barbell-curl.cue: Elbows at the sides, body still. Curl to the chest, lower slowly.

barbell-glute-bridge.cue: Bar over the hips, feet flat. Drive up, squeeze 2 sec, ribs down.

barbell-upright-row.cue: Hands shoulder-width. Lead with the elbows, stop at shoulder height.

bayesian-cable-curl.cue: Face away from a low cable, arm behind the body. Curl from the stretch.

bent-over-db-reverse-fly.cue: Hinge near flat, back neutral. Raise out wide, pinkies leading.

bicycle-crunch.cue: Slow. Opposite elbow to knee, other leg long.

bird-dog.cue: Reach the opposite arm and leg long. Pause 2 sec, hips level.

bird-dog-plank.cue: From a high plank, lift the opposite arm and leg. No twist.

bird-dog-plank-hybrid.cue: From a high plank, lift the opposite arm and leg. No twist.

bodyweight-calf-raise.cue: On a step, hand on a wall. Full stretch, 2-sec pause up top.

bodyweight-reverse-lunge.cue: Hands on hips. Step back, drop the back knee, drive up the front heel.

bulgarian-split-squat.cue: Rear foot on the bench. Upright torso, drop straight down.

bulgarian-split-squat-dbs.cue: Rear foot on the bench. Upright torso, drop straight down.

cable-crossover-fly.cue: Pulleys at shoulder height. Soft elbows, hug until the hands meet.

cable-crunch.cue: Kneel, rope by the ears. Crunch down, rounding the upper spine.

cable-curl.cue: Elbows pinned, stand tall. Curl to the chest, lower slowly.

cable-curl-drop-set.cue: Elbows pinned, stand tall. Curl to the chest, lower slowly.

cable-external-rotation.cue: Elbow pinned to the side. Rotate the hand out, slow back.

cable-glute-kickback.cue: Strap on the ankle, hold the frame. Kick back and up, no back arch.

cable-kickback.cue: Low pulley, hinge forward. Upper arm still, extend straight back.

cable-lateral-raise.cue: Cable behind the body. Lead with the elbow to shoulder height.

cable-leg-curl.cue: Strap on the ankle, hold the frame. Thigh still, curl heel to glute.

cable-overhead-extension.cue: Face away from a low pulley. Elbows by the ears, stretch, extend.

cable-pull-through.cue: Face away, rope between the legs. Hips back, then squeeze them through.

cable-pullover.cue: Head to a low pulley. Sweep the rope over to the hips, arms straight.

cable-reverse-fly.cue: Cables crossed at shoulder height. Sweep back wide, arms long.

cable-rope-hammer-curl.cue: Rope, thumbs up, elbows pinned. Curl the rope ends to the shoulders.

cable-upright-row.cue: Low pulley, rope. Pull the elbows out to chest height, no higher.

cable-woodchop.cue: Cable high to one side. Pull across and down to the far hip, turning.

captains-chair-knee-raise.cue: Back flat on the pad. Knees to chest, curl the pelvis, lower slowly.

captains-chair-leg-raise.cue: Back flat on the pad. Straight legs to hip height, lower slowly.

chest-supported-db-row.cue: Chest on the bench. Pull to the hips, pause and squeeze at the top.

chest-supported-t-bar-row.cue: Chest on the pad, feet planted. Pull to the lower chest, lower slowly.

chin-ups.cue: Underhand, shoulder width. Full hang, chest to the bar.

close-grip-bench-press.cue: Hands shoulder-width, elbows tucked. Bar to lower chest, lock out.

close-grip-lat-pulldown.cue: Neutral handle. Full stretch at the top, elbows to ribs.

concentration-curl.cue: Elbow on the inner thigh. Curl to the shoulder, squeeze, lower slowly.

copenhagen-plank.cue: Top leg on the bench, side plank on the forearm. Hips high.

crunch.cue: Knees bent, hands at temples. Curl ribs to hips, don't pull the head.

db-bench-press.cue: Feet planted. Lower deep, press up and slightly in.

db-curl.cue: Elbows at the sides, palms up. Curl to the shoulders, lower in 2-3 s.

db-floor-press.cue: Knees bent. Lower till upper arms touch the floor, pause, press.

db-kickback.cue: Knee and hand on the bench. Upper arm level, extend back, squeeze.

db-lateral-raise.cue: Lead with the elbows to shoulder height. No swing.

db-lying-extension.cue: Palms facing. Lower beside the ears, extend without flaring.

db-overhead-extension.cue: Sit tall. Cup one dumbbell, lower behind the head, elbows in.

db-preacher-curl.cue: Armpit on the pad, one arm. Full stretch, no bounce, slow lower.

db-pullover.cue: One DB in both hands. Lower behind the head, ribs down, pull back up.

db-romanian-deadlift.cue: Soft knees, flat back. Hips back, DBs down the thighs to the stretch.

db-split-squat.cue: Long split stance, DBs at the sides. Drop straight down, torso upright.

dead-bug.cue: Low back pressed down. Reach the opposite arm and leg out, switch.

decline-barbell-bench-press.cue: Feet locked in. Bar to lower chest, press straight up.

decline-crunch.cue: Feet hooked. Curl up until the low back lifts, lower slowly.

decline-push-up.cue: Feet on the bench, hips level. Lower the head toward the floor.

deficit-push-up.cue: Hands on dumbbells, wrists straight. Lower past the hands.

ez-bar-curl.cue: Grip the inner angles, elbows pinned. Curl up, no leaning back.

ez-bar-overhead-extension.cue: Sit tall. Lower the bar behind the head, elbows in, extend.

ez-bar-skull-crusher.cue: Lower behind the head for more stretch. Elbows stay in.

face-pulls.cue: Rope to the eyebrows, elbows high, pull the ends apart.

glute-bridge.cue: On your back, feet flat. Squeeze the glutes 3 sec at the top.

glute-bridge-with-hold.cue: On your back, feet flat. Squeeze the glutes 3 sec at the top.

goblet-squat.cue: DB at the chest. Sit between the heels, elbows inside the knees.

hack-squat.cue: Back flat on the pad. Lower deep, drive up through the whole foot.

half-kneeling-pallof-press.cue: Inside knee down, glute tight. Press out from the chest, no twist.

hammer-curl.cue: Thumbs up, elbows at the sides. No swing.

hanging-knee-raise.cue: Hang still. Knees up past the hips, tilt the pelvis. Lower slowly.

hanging-knee-to-elbow-twist.cue: Hang still. Knees up and across toward the opposite elbow.

hanging-leg-raise.cue: No swinging. Raise the legs, curl the pelvis toward the ribs.

high-cable-curl.cue: Arms out at shoulder height. Curl the handles to the ears.

hip-thrust.cue: Upper back on the bench. Pause 2 sec at the top, chin tucked.

hollow-body-hold.cue: Low back flat, arms overhead, legs low. Bend the knees if it lifts.

incline-barbell-bench-press.cue: 30° bench. Bar to upper chest, press back over the shoulders.

incline-db-curl.cue: 45° bench, arms hang behind the body. Slow 3-second lower.

incline-db-fly.cue: 30° bench, soft elbows. Open wide, hug the weights over the face.

incline-db-press.cue: 30° bench. Deep stretch at the bottom, drive up.

incline-db-reverse-fly.cue: Chest on the bench. Raise out wide to shoulder height, pause.

incline-machine-press.cue: Handles at the upper chest. Press up and in, slow on the way back.

incline-y-raise.cue: Chest on the bench, thumbs up. Raise in a Y to ear height. Go light.

inverted-row.cue: Body straight, heels down. Pull the chest to the bar.

iso-lateral-row.cue: Chest on the pad. Row one or both arms, elbows back, pause and squeeze.

kneeling-side-plank.cue: Knees bent and stacked, elbow under shoulder. Hips up in line, hold.

l-sit.cue: Shoulders pushed down, legs level. Tuck the knees if you must.

l-sit-progression.cue: Shoulders pushed down, legs level. Tuck the knees if you must.

landmine-press.cue: Staggered stance, bar at the shoulder. Press up and forward.

landmine-squat.cue: Bar end at the chest, lean into it. Sit down between the heels.

lat-pulldown.cue: Hands outside the shoulders. Bar to the upper chest, chest up.

lean-away-lateral-raise.cue: Hold the upright, lean away. Raise from the hip to shoulder height.

leg-extension.cue: Sit back, pad on the shins. Squeeze 1 sec at the top.

leg-press.cue: Feet mid-plate. Stop before the hips lift off the pad.

leg-press-calf-raise.cue: Balls of the feet on the plate edge, knees still. Full stretch, push up.

low-to-high-cable-fly.cue: Pulleys low. Sweep the hands up and together to chin height.

lying-hamstring-curl.cue: Hips pressed down. Curl up, 3-second lower.

lying-leg-raise.cue: Hands under hips. Lower straight legs only while the back stays flat.

machine-biceps-curl.cue: Elbows in line with the pivot. Curl up, lower for 3 seconds.

machine-chest-press.cue: Handles at mid-chest. Press out, control the way back.

machine-chest-press-or-flat-bench.cue: Handles at mid-chest. Press out, control the way back.

machine-hip-thrust.cue: Back on the pad, belt over the hips. Drive up, pause 2 sec, ribs down.

machine-lateral-raise.cue: Chest on the pad. Push the pads out with the elbows.

machine-row.cue: Chest on the pad, handles at chest height. Squeeze the blades back.

machine-shoulder-press.cue: Back supported. Two seconds down, stop just above the shoulders.

max-rep-set.cue: Strict: full hang, chin over the bar. Crisp reps, never grinding.

mountain-climber.cue: High plank, hips level. Drive one knee to the chest at a time.

negative-pull-ups.cue: Step up to chin over the bar. Lower for 3 to 5 seconds.

neutral-grip-pull-ups.cue: Palms facing on parallel handles. Full hang, elbows to ribs.

nordic-curl.cue: Heels hooked, hips straight. Lower as slowly as you can, push back up.

one-arm-db-row.cue: Hand and knee on the bench, back flat. Pull the DB to the hip.

overhead-cable-extension.cue: Face away from a low pulley. Elbows by the ears, stretch, extend.

pallof-press.cue: Stand side-on. Press straight out and back, resist the twist.

pec-deck-fly.cue: Back on the pad. Bring the handles together, slow on the way back.

pike-push-up.cue: Hips high. Lower the head just in front of the hands, press up.

pistol-squat.cue: Free leg straight out front. Sit all the way down, heel flat.

plank.cue: Forearms down, plate on the upper back. Glutes tight, no sag.

plank-shoulder-tap.cue: High plank, feet wide. Tap the other shoulder, hips still.

plate-front-raise.cue: Plate at 3 and 9 o'clock. Raise to eye level, no leaning back.

preacher-curl.cue: Armpits on the pad. Full stretch at the bottom, no bounce.

pull-ups.cue: Strict: full hang, chin over the bar. Crisp reps, never grinding.

push-up.cue: Body in one line. Chest to a fist from the floor, press up.

reverse-crunch.cue: Knees at 90°. Curl the hips off the floor toward the ribs. No swing.

reverse-curl.cue: Palms down, wrists straight, elbows pinned. Curl up, lower slowly.

reverse-grip-pushdown.cue: Palms up, elbows tight to the ribs. Push to lockout, slow up.

reverse-lunge.cue: DBs at the sides. Step back, drop the knee, drive up off the front heel.

reverse-pec-deck.cue: Chest on the pad. Sweep back to the sides, squeeze the rear delts.

rope-pushdown.cue: Elbows pinned to the ribs. Spread the rope at the bottom.

russian-twist.cue: Lean back 45°, feet up, plate at the chest. Rotate slowly.

russian-twist-weighted.cue: Lean back 45°, feet up, plate at the chest. Rotate slowly.

scapular-pull-ups.cue: Arms straight. Pull the shoulders down and back, lower slowly.

seal-row.cue: Lie face down on the high bench. Row the bar up to the bench.

seated-barbell-press.cue: Back on the pad. Bar from collarbone to straight over the head.

seated-cable-row.cue: Sit tall, knees soft. Pull the handle to the belly, no rocking.

seated-calf-raise.cue: Pad on the lower thighs. Full stretch, rise high, 2-sec pause.

seated-db-lateral-raise.cue: Sit tall on the bench end. Raise to shoulder height, no swing.

seated-db-shoulder-press.cue: Back on the bench, no arching. Lower to ear level, press up.

seated-dip-machine.cue: Sit tall. Press down to lockout, hands back up to chest level.

seated-leg-curl.cue: Thigh pad snug, lean forward a little. Curl fully, 3-sec lower.

side-lying-db-external-rotation.cue: Elbow on the hip at 90°. Rotate the dumbbell up slowly.

side-plank-with-reach.cue: Side plank. Reach the top arm under and through, then to the ceiling.

single-arm-cable-pushdown.cue: Elbow pinned, other hand on the stack. Push to lockout.

single-arm-cable-row.cue: Stretch forward, then pull the elbow to the hip.

single-arm-db-overhead-extension.cue: Elbow up by the head. Lower behind the head, extend fully.

single-arm-lat-pulldown.cue: Reach up for a full stretch, pull the elbow to the hip.

single-leg-db-calf-raise.cue: One foot on a step, DB in that hand. Full stretch, 2-sec pause up top.

single-leg-extension.cue: One leg, pad on the low shin. Squeeze at the top, lower slowly.

single-leg-glute-bridge.cue: One foot down, other knee to chest. Hips level, squeeze at the top.

single-leg-hip-thrust.cue: Upper back on the bench, one foot down. Hips level, pause at the top.

single-leg-press.cue: One foot mid-plate. Keep the hips down, press through the heel.

single-leg-rdl.cue: DB in the opposite hand, hips square. Back leg and torso move as one.

sissy-squat.cue: On the toes, hold a support. Knees forward, lean back, hips straight.

smith-bench-press.cue: Bar meets lower chest. Lower under control, press without bouncing.

smith-calf-raise.cue: Bar on the back, balls of feet on a step. Straight knees, 2-sec pause.

smith-incline-press.cue: 30° bench, bar meets upper chest. Lower slow, press without bouncing.

smith-machine-shoulder-press.cue: Back on the pad, bar in front of the face. Lower to chin, press up.

smith-machine-squat.cue: Feet a little ahead of the bar. Sit to parallel, back tall.

spider-curl.cue: Chest on a 45° bench, arms hanging. Curl up hard, lower slowly.

stability-ball-back-extension.cue: Hips on the ball, feet on the wall. Lift to a straight line, no arching.

stability-ball-leg-curl.cue: Heels on the ball, hips up. Roll the ball in, keep the hips high.

stability-ball-rollout.cue: Kneel, forearms on the ball. Roll out, ribs down, back before it sags.

standing-barbell-press.cue: Glutes tight, ribs down. Bar straight up, head through at the top.

standing-cable-press.cue: Split stance, ribs down. Press forward and together.

standing-calf-raise.cue: Full stretch at the bottom, 2-sec pause, rise high.

standing-db-shoulder-press.cue: Glutes and abs tight. Press straight up, no leaning back.

step-up.cue: Whole foot on the bench. Drive up through the heel, no push from below.

stir-the-pot.cue: Forearms on the ball, body straight. Small circles, hips stay still.

straight-arm-pulldown.cue: Arms straight, slight hinge. Sweep the bar to the thighs.

straight-bar-pushdown.cue: Elbows pinned, wrists straight. Push the bar to the thighs.

suitcase-carry.cue: One heavy DB at one side. Walk tall without leaning, then switch.

superman-hold.cue: Face down. Lift arms and legs a little, hold 3 sec. Look at the floor.

suspension-trainer-row.cue: Lean back, body straight. Pull the hands to the ribs.

tibialis-raise.cue: Back on the wall, heels a foot out. Toes up high, lower slowly.

toe-touches.cue: Legs straight up. Reach for the toes, shoulders off the floor.

toes-to-bar.cue: Straight arms press the bar down. Toes to the bar, no kip.

triceps-extension-machine.cue: Elbows on the pivot. Extend fully, slow return.

underhand-lat-pulldown.cue: Palms toward you. Bar to the upper chest, elbows down and in.

volume-sets.cue: Strict: full hang, chin over the bar. Crisp reps, never grinding.

walking-lunge.cue: Long steps, DBs at the sides. Back knee near the floor, drive forward.

wall-sit.cue: Back flat on the wall, thighs level, shins vertical. Hold and breathe.

weighted-plank.cue: Forearms down, plate on the upper back. Glutes tight, no sag.

weighted-pull-ups.cue: Dip belt. Full hang, chin over the bar.

wide-grip-seated-cable-row.cue: Overhand, wide bar. Pull to the lower chest, elbows out at 45°.
